items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday’s game vs the Rams. He’ll rest ailing ankle for long-term healing; no IR plans.
items.why: Ankle injury bothering for weeks; rest for long-term.
items.implication: ARI RB depth chart opens; committee or backups elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for remaining ARI RBs.

items.text: Ravens ruled out QB Lamar Jackson for Sunday’s game at Cleveland due to his ankle injury.
items.why: Ankle injury; second straight week out.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley likely starts; Flowers/Likely/Andrews ceiling reduced without Lamar.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and pass-catcher volume shifts.

items.text: Jets once again ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday vs Patriots.
items.implication: Braelon Allen continues as lead back with heavy opportunity share.
items.opportunity: Nearly full Jets RB snaps/carries to Allen.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson diagnosed with high-ankle sprain but practiced this week and feels pretty good; game-time TBD.
items.why: High-ankle sprain from Week 5; surprised he could practice.
items.implication: Possible limited role or sit; monitor final status vs volume for Stevenson.
items.opportunity: If limited/OUT, Rhamondre Stevenson full volume.

items.text: Falcons QB Michael Penix Jr. has no injury designation and is expected to start vs Bears (ribs cleared).
items.opportunity: Stable QB play boosts ATL skill players.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) ruled OUT for Week 6 London game vs Jaguars along with Tank Dell and Jalen Pitre.
items.implication: Woody Marks or committee elevated for full workload in London.
items.opportunity: RB snaps/carries/red-zone to backups; MHJ debut boosts WR corps.

items.text: Jalen Hurts ruled out Week 6 with superficial blood clot; Berry likes Tanner McKee as replacement start.
items.implication: McKee starts behind makeshift line; Saquon/Smith uncertain; Eagles total low.
items.opportunity: Possible boost to Saquon if active or Goedert/WRs; Panthers DST upgrade.

items.text: Levitan agrees Eagles should risk moving on Saquon a year early rather than late given age; loves watching him but notes trade-early precedent.
items.why: Age/Eagles trade-early history; worth risk of early move.
items.implication: Long-term value caution; short-term monitor hamstring with Hurts out.
items.opportunity: If limited, handcuff or committee impact.

items.text: Berry LOVES Mike Evans vs WSH as his WR4; Washington defense is a buffet for pass catchers.
items.why: Elite matchup vs Commanders secondary; high ranking.

items.text: Berry LOVES Drake London vs CHI (WR6) citing bankable usage.
Berry LOVES Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5); elite recent usage vs leaky run D.
items.why: Elite usage + favorable run defense matchup.

items.text: Berry LOVES Rhamondre Stevenson vs NYJ (RB9) for volume vs leaky run D.
items.why: Volume + matchup; potential full if Henderson limited.

items.text: Berry HATES Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) due to tough matchup and QB issues.
items.why: Ugly matchup vs Seattle + shaky QB situation; also shoulder Q in TNF.
items.conflict: Returned from shoulder in TNF but still faded.

items.text: Berry HATES Bo Nix vs SEA (QB23) and Justin Herbert @ KC (QB25); toughest pass D and low total/rut.
items.why: Nix faces elite pass D; Herbert low team total and scoring struggles.
